top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs Warns on Russia-Driven Diesel Squeeze
top_signals.summary: Samantha Dart, co-head of global commodities research at Goldman Sachs, joined Haslinda Amin on Insight with Haslinda Amin to discuss growing risks in diesel markets. Dart says disruptions to Russian fuel exports and the US-Iran war are tightening supplies, raising concerns about global refining capacity and fuel prices. (Source: Bloomberg)
